summary: Join Swiggy's team as a React Native developer and help us build seamless digital experiences for our users.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain React Native applications for iOS and Android, ensuring optimal performance and responsiveness.
Collaborate with the frontend team to integrate seamless user experiences.
Manage and deploy updates in line with Swiggy's business needs.
Conduct code reviews to uphold code quality standards.
Identify bugs and implement effective solutions using React Native.
Write unit and integration tests using React Native Testing Library to ensure app reliability.
Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.
Work closely with cross-team developers to identify technical specifications.
Ensure immediate availability for project-critical tasks as needed by Swiggy's timelines.
Participate in daily scrums to report progress and identify bottlenecks.
nice_to_have_skills: App performance optimization (profiling, reducing memory usage, minimizing bundle size)
Unit testing using React Native Testing Library
